mapper.select: SELECT m.match_num AS matchNum, TO_CHAR(m.match_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS matchDate, m.match_time AS matchTime, m.home_score AS homeScore, m.away_score AS awayScore, s.stadium_name AS stadiumName, hc.club_name AS homeClubName, hc.club_logo AS homeClubLogo, ac.club_name AS awayClubName, ac.club_logo AS awayClubLogo FROM Match m LEFT OUTER JOIN Match_Apply ma ON m.apply_id = ma.apply_id LEFT OUTER JOIN Stadium s ON ma.stadium_id = s.stadium_id LEFT OUTER JOIN Club hc ON ma.clubOwner_key = hc.clubOwner_key LEFT OUTER JOIN Club ac ON ma.clubOwner_key2 = ac.clubOwner_key ORDER BY m.match_date DESC, m.match_num DESC
